description: Page numbers are treated as starting at 0, so every page is shifted by one page.
report_specific: paginate(list(range(1, 11)), 1, 4) returns [5, 6, 7, 8] instead of [1, 2, 3, 4]. Page 1 should be the first page.
report_vague: The product list skips the first few items, and the last page of results is empty.
